text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"By the time I was old enough to understand things,
my mother was already a well-known stage actor."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you do not cast your qualifications aside,
they will always remain in your hands."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—Even without a sword, even if you cannot surge to the top,
you still have your own path to walk."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thousands of spectators held their breath,
waiting for a single word from her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With every single breath, with every single move she made,
thousands of spectators were captivated by the dream...!

text_block_list.name: Young Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Someday, I want to――just like that...
(Waaaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Haa!

A memorable first day of climbing the ranks
in the Twinkle Series alongside Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku! Not bad at all, Fuji-kun!
More! Increase your speed even mooore!

Fuji Kiseki had gotten wrapped up in an experiment
by Agnes Tachyon—a rather eccentric Umamusume
who dedicated everything to research.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*! Keeping us on the edge of our seats right until that final top speed! Fuji-senpai, you're so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Even though she hasn't debuted yet! I'm sure she'll put up amazing results from now on~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The gallery has grown quite a bit.
They seem to have very high expectations of you, Fuji-kun.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. I'm lucky so many of them
have taken a liking to me. They've been a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I feel those expectant gazes, it makes me feel like
I have to put on an even better show, you know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? ...Well, setting aside
your rather eccentric sensibilities for now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That gave me some great data! Before a debut, I needed legs capable of reaching a certain speed, you see!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
There's a wonderful variety of guinea pi—
Umamusume here! Come again anytime!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Anytime!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and also... aren't you
taking on the Twinkle Series
starting today?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Daydreaming during a race means you aren't watching where you're going.
Do your best and try not to get injured."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, darn, you saw right through me.
I still have a long way to go, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Thinking of today as the day it all begins...
I found myself reminiscing about the past.)

text_block_list.name: Young Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for everything today!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so glad for Fuji Kiseki.
She tried so hard!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right? You just can't help but cheer for them.
I'm already looking forward to the next performance~

text_block_list.name: Young Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
............
I was doing my best, huh...

text_block_list.name: Young Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mom. I wonder if I can become
an entertainer just like you.

text_block_list.name: Young Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will the day ever come when I can receive huge, resounding applause like that...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
—Fuji. Listen to me.
You must not simply chase after me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
There isn't just one path,
broaden your perspective.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You must strive for heights
that only you can reach."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —A place only I can reach... huh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...
I wonder if I've finally reached the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fans
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpaaai!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible~!
That duel of pure speed against Tachyon-san~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to seeing you shine in the Twinkle Series, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, thank you!
I'll do my best to live up to everyone's expectations!

That day's training came to an end
in a lively atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer! Good work today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today is a memorable day for you and me, isn't it?
There's something I want to tell you once again.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Right now, you and I are at the beginning
of a glorious journey together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The goal, of course, is to become the ultimate entertainer—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "That's exactly why there's a summit I want to reach first in the Classic tier!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: As you know, claiming the Classic Triple Crown...!

The Classic Triple Crown is a title bestowed
only upon those who conquer the
Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho.

Few umamusume have ever achieved this.
Hence, that honor is the aspiration of many.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I am delighted that so many sweet little ponies
place their hopes in me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to live up to their expectations on that summit.
I want to give them the catharsis of glory...!

"If you aim to be the greatest entertainer,
there is no grander stage in the Classic year."

Above all, responding to your trainee's passion
is a Trainer's duty. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you!
I knew you would say that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now then, we've decided on the first peak to aim for, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Winning the Triple Crown was merely the prologue!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The back I chase belongs to a great entertainer. The story won't end so easily.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not only is it a long, thorny path,
there's no guarantee we'll even reach the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"However—'Resolve is everything. What could
anyone know of a life left behind?'!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not taking on the challenge isn't an option!
—That is why, once more, I want to steel our resolve together.

Fuji Kiseki dropped to one knee
and pulled a single flower out of thin air.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will you walk this thorny path with me?

Beneath the moonlit sky, her gaze gleamed straight and true with strength.
Guided by that brilliance,
I found myself accepting the flower before I even realized it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
That's my Trainer for you.
The offered flower was a beautiful, drooping purple blossom.

—And so began the days of climbing
the Twinkle Series together with Fuji Kiseki.
